A pharmacist is reviewing product-specific dispensing restrictions as of October 26, 2026. The question does not apply any future iPLEDGE implementation before its effective date. Each option describes a separate work-queue record. Assume all other prerequisites are satisfied; judge the action and facts actually stated, not an unstated exception.

Which ONE proposed handling is supported by the applicable requirements?

A.original_choice_text: A pharmacist requires enrollment in the removed clozapine REMS before considering any clozapine prescription.
A.finding_ko: 이 사례의 오답. 2025-06-13 제거 이후 prescriber/pharmacy/patient 의 REMS 참여 및 ANC registry 보고는 dispensing 선행요건이 아니다. 제거된 enrollment 를 필수장벽으로 복구하지 않는다.

A HIPAA-covered Massachusetts pharmacy receives requests involving identifiable patient information. No emergency disclosure exception or special judicial order applies unless stated. Each option describes a separate work-queue record. Assume all other prerequisites are satisfied; judge the action and facts actually stated, not an unstated exception.
